**The important catch is solar recharge speed.** A 200W panel typically harvests roughly **600–750Wh over five peak-sun hours**—not enough to refill an empty 1kWh battery in that window. That makes the ALLPOWERS 400W bundle especially appealing for repeated off-grid use, while the EcoFlow is my preference for mixed camping and outage duty. citeturn0search0
